cs.t: I have an Evodesk, which is the cheaper version of the NextDesk. I picked it because I was able to get a curved work surface without a significant added cost, along with a memory controller (save your height settings and 1 click adjustment from sit-to-stand), and a cable tray. It's sturdy enough for my laptop and 2 monitors from my sit height (~25ish? inches) to my stand height (~46? inches). The cable tray was a bit difficult to fit a surge protector into but I eventually found one that worked. The top is a bit different from normal desks, but it feels fine to rest against and use my laser mouse sans mousepad. Most of my coworkers have some variant of the Geek Desk.
